title: GBN-AG accompanying document types
description: The document types a notifier can attach to a GBN-AG pre-notification, and the code each one is sent as in exchangedDocument.referenceDocument[].typeCode. Most types map to a UN/CEFACT document code (UNTDID 1001, D16B); the three types UNTDID 1001 does not cover are given Defra codes GBN1 to GBN3. Each entry's codeList is the urlId that accompanies its typeCode, so a consumer always knows which vocabulary a code belongs to. A document type with no confident mapping defaults to 916 (Related document). All codes are strings. Values are listed with the UNTDID 1001 codes first in numerical order, then the Defra codes in numerical order. This file is the working source of truth in the absence of a live Defra reference-data service; when that service goes live at https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/, this file is retired and the URL stays the same.
